meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞：游智婷／曲：陳麒安

lines.a: 耶穌降生 普天同慶
兩千年前 為你為我
lines.b: long, long ago, for you and me

lines.a: 小小君王 在馬槽裡
天使天軍 報好消息
lines.b: Angels and saints tell of this day
So let us come and proclaim His name
Spread Good News to all the earth

lines.a: 耶穌降生在世上 使你我有盼望
lines.b: Jesus, born into this world, He came down to give us hope
In the dark, He is the light
So let us come and proclaim His name
For He is the prince of peace

lines.a: 耶穌降生在世上 一切再也不一樣
lines.b: Jesus, born into this world, we will never be the same

lines.a: 耶穌降生在世上 一切再也不一樣
lines.b: Jesus, born into this world, we will never be the same
